You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop of swapping the "eye of newt" and "spider egg" in my inventory because I was trying to carry both ingredients to the kitchen at once, ignoring the two-item limit. I also failed to realize that I could simply drop an ingredient in the pantry, go to the kitchen to use it, and return to the pantry for the next one, rather than trying to transport them all simultaneously. Furthermore, I neglected to retrieve the "bucket of ectoplasm" which I had dropped in the cellar (where it floated to the ceiling) and the "fairy wand" which I dropped in the pantry.

My new strategy is:
1.  **Retrieve the Ectoplasm:** Go to the cellar, take the "bucket of ectoplasm" (which is on the ceiling), and immediately go to the kitchen to pour it into the cauldron.
2.  **Retrieve the Wand:** Go to the pantry, take the "fairy wand" (which is on the floor), go to the kitchen, and use it over the cauldron.
3.  **Process Ingredients Sequentially:** Instead of trying to carry multiple ingredients:
    *   Go to the pantry, take the "peach", go to the kitchen, add it to the cauldron, then drop the peach (or leave it) and return to the pantry.
    *   Go to the pantry, take the "eye of newt", go to the kitchen, add it to the cauldron.
    *   Go to the pantry, take the "spider egg", go to the kitchen, add it to the cauldron.
4.  **Finish:** Once all steps are complete, type "> done".

This approach respects the inventory limit by processing one ingredient at a time and ensures I retrieve the items I previously dropped.
